gold: Right Bundle Branch Block (RBBB) with cardiac arrest due to hypoxemia from COPD exacerbation

selector.rationale: ECG findings of prolonged QRS duration with rsR' complexes in lead V1 and right axis deviation support Brugada syndrome, despite the patient's history of COPD and shortness of breath

rejected.label: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) exacerbation
rejected.why: while COPD exacerbation could explain shortness of breath, it does not account for the specific ECG findings

rejected.label: Acute coronary syndrome
rejected.why: coronary angiography showed no acute occlusions

rejected.label: Right ventricular hypertrophy
rejected.why: while some ECG findings are consistent with right ventricular hypertrophy, they are more specific for Brugada syndrome

rejected.label: Hypoxemic cardiac arrest
rejected.why: although hypoxemic cardiac arrest could be a consequence of COPD exacerbation, the ECG findings point more directly to Brugada syndrome
